description: This PHP file defines a function 'display_email_lines' that generates HTML and JavaScript for managing email recipient lines in different views (EditView and DetailView) within the SuiteCRM platform. It interacts with global variables, external JavaScript, and CRM beans to display and process email recipient data.

methods.name: display_email_lines
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript to display and manage email recipient lines in different views within SuiteCRM.
